## Architecture Designed for LLM Blast Radius

Why enforce compact components? Because LLMs hallucinate when asked to edit 400-line files with 12 nested hooks. Chemical X defaults to bounded component weight—colocating state, enforcing single responsibility, and preventing silent regressions. Configurable out of the box via .chemxrc .

Arbitrary 100-line rules enforced for aesthetic purism or stylistic pedantry.

Bounded Blast Radius. When an LLM edits a 60-line component, its attention focus is laser-sharp. In a 450-line file with 12 hooks, the model hallucinates variable state and introduces silent regressions.

Strictly ban native HTML tags everywhere outside an arbitrary 'atom' directory.

Design-system boundary enforcement and encapsulated primitive auditing. Ensure raw tags carry consistent accessibility, focus states, and design tokens rather than ad-hoc inline mutations.

An inflexible framework that forces you to rewrite your entire tech stack from scratch.

100% configurable via .chemxrc. Adjust line limits, ignore legacy paths, customize AI slop thresholds, and configure token budgets to match your team's existing conventions.

## Master MCP Gateway & SQLite Concurrency

Beyond search and passive memory: Chemical X provides active multi-agent concurrency leases and closed-loop verification for autonomous development teams.

### Master MCP Gateway (chemx)

Eliminates per-tool confirmation prompts. A single chemx({ action, params }) call gives agents verified file patching, AST querying, line slicing, and test execution without prompt fatigue.

### SQLite Concurrency & File Leases

Dedicated file_leases and file_lock_queue SQLite tables in WAL mode prevent race conditions when multiple autonomous agents edit the same repository simultaneously.

### Closed-Loop Gated Verification

When an agent reports a task 'Done', Chemical X automatically re-runs the rule against the AST. Completion is strictly rejected unless the violation is provably eliminated.
